subject: Enablement sprint roster + cutover calendar (12-week MAP)
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Rana <aisha.rana@helixsolutions.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 Nov 2025 15:04:00 -0800
Subject: Enablement sprint roster + cutover calendar (12-week MAP)

Hi Aisha —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Per our conversation, I pulled together a proposed 12-week mutual action plan that breaks the rollout into staged enablement sprints, owner assignments, and acceptance gates. I attached a lightweight MAP (MAP_Helix_v1.xlsx) and an initial SOW draft for procurement visibility.

High level asks from your side:
- Confirm the product champion (who will own acceptance criteria) and a technical lead for integration testing.
- Approve the cutover weekend window options (we proposed Dec 20–21 or Jan 10–11).
- Confirm whether Helix needs on-prem packaging or standard VPC delivery (this affects staging timelines).

Quick summary of the plan inside the MAP:
1) Weeks 1–2: Kickoff & environment provisioning (Owners: Rishi / Helix infra lead)
2) Weeks 3–6: Integration & ingest validation (Owners: Marissa / Helix eng)
3) Weeks 7–9: Performance tuning, load tests, and fallbacks (Owners: Ben / Redwood infra)
4) Weeks 10–12: Acceptance, docs handoff, and go-live cutover (Owners: Marissa / Helix PM)

I’ve left a few placeholder dates — if you can confirm the product champion and preferred cutover window, we’ll lock the calendar and produce an updated MAP v1.1 for signatures.

Attached: MAP_Helix_v1.xlsx (milestones + owner roster), SOW_draft_Helix_v2.pdf (commercial outline)

Thanks,
Rishi
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
From: Aisha Rana <aisha.rana@helixsolutions.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Whitaker <tom.whitaker@helixsolutions.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 Nov 2025 09:11:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Enablement sprint roster + cutover calendar (12-week MAP)

Rishi —

Appreciate the clear structure. Quick answers:
- Product champion: Tom Whitaker (cc’d) — he’ll own acceptance criteria.
- Technical lead: I’ll assign Sara Patel from our platform team; she’ll be included on integration threads starting next week.
- Cutover window: Jan 10–11 is preferable for us (Dec has year-end freeze).
- Delivery: VPC delivery is fine; we’ll request the on-prem package only if regulatory scoping expands.

Tom and I reviewed the MAP and have two immediate asks before we lock dates:
1) Can you add an explicit rollback plan / decision gate for Week 10 acceptance? We want clear abort criteria.
2) A simple dependency matrix that shows which Helix teams must complete tasks before your staging environment goes live.

If you can incorporate those items, we can sign off on the timeline by Fri Nov 28.

Best,
Aisha
VP Product, Helix Solutions
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Rana <aisha.rana@helixsolutions.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 Nov 2025 10:32:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Enablement sprint roster + cutover calendar (12-week MAP)

Thanks Aisha — and welcome Tom.

Per your asks I updated the MAP:
- Added a Week 10 decision gate with explicit rollback criteria (including cutover abort checklist and failover steps). Entered owner = Ben Carter for rollback verification.
- Added a compact dependency matrix mapping Helix deliverables (API contract signoff, test data set, security review) to Redwood staging milestones.

I’m attaching MAP_Helix_v1.1 (calendar locked to Jan 10–11 cutover) and SOW_draft_Helix_v2 (minor commercial tweaks). Notable changes: we reduced the tuning window by 1 week but added two targeted load test runs in Week 8.

Open items we should close this week:
- Product champion confirmation (Tom) — please confirm primary acceptance criteria owner and their SLA expectation for signoff turnaround.
- Sara Patel intro to Marissa for integration runbook alignment (Aisha to introduce).
- Procurement: confirm if Helix requires invoice milestone billing vs. net-30 on go-live.

If we get those answers by Thu Nov 27, Marissa will produce a final MAP for signature on Fri Nov 28.

Thanks,
Rishi
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Rana <aisha.rana@helixsolutions.com>, Tom Whitaker <tom.whitaker@helixsolutions.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 27 Nov 2025 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Enablement sprint roster + cutover calendar (12-week MAP)

Hi Aisha/Tom —

Marissa here (implementation lead). Thanks for confirming the cutover window. A few practical delivery notes pulled from the MAP that I want to call out so your teams can prepare:
- Integration runbook: we need the API contract signed and a representative test dataset at least 10 business days before Week 3 kickoffs. If Sara can get that to me by Mon Dec 1 we’ll be on track.
- Staging environment access: we’ll provision IAM roles and IP allowlist the week of Dec 8 — please share the CIDR ranges for your test agents.
- Acceptance criteria template: attached to MAP v1.1 under the ‘Acceptance’ tab — helps speed signoff.

Risk flags (things that would push timeline):
- On-prem requirement added after provisioning would add ~3 weeks.
- Security questionnaire delays (SOC2 evidence) beyond Dec 10 will block Week 5 load tests.

I’ll run a 30-minute alignment call with Sara + Tom next Tue (Dec 2) to walk through the integration runbook and the acceptance checklist. Invite will be posted after Aisha introduces Sara.

—Marissa
Senior Implementation Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Tom Whitaker <tom.whitaker@helixsolutions.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aisha Rana <aisha.rana@helixsolutions.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 Nov 2025 09:20:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Enablement sprint roster + cutover calendar (12-week MAP)

Marissa / Rishi —

Thanks for the updates and for adding the rollback gate. I’ve reviewed MAP_v1.1 (attached) and confirm:
- I’ll own acceptance criteria and commit to a 48-hour turnaround on signoff items during Weeks 10–12.
- Sara Patel will be on copy for the integration call — Aisha will intro her later today.
- Procurement: we prefer milestone invoicing (50% on kickoff, 40% on acceptance, 10% on 30-day post-go-live). I’ve asked our procurement lead to send payment terms to Ben.

We’re aligned to Jan 10–11 cutover. Please send the final MAP for signatures once the procurement cadence is confirmed.

Tom
VP Engineering, Helix Solutions
